config.primary_endpoint: Terminal actual clean-response squared error averaged over nine queries within trajectory
config.selection: One policy per method on equally weighted three-condition curved validation mixture; plane uses separate beta=1 validation control
config.shrinkage_selection: For each beta, minimize the pooled validation quadratic over continuous rho in[0,1]; one rho shared across trajectories and curved conditions. Coarse rho curves are diagnostics, not the optimization restriction.
config.sensing: Known applied force and noisy instantaneous solver velocity only. Positions are plant/scoring records, not encoder measurements.
config.observation: Known isotropic viscous resistance in matched laws; fixed true sigma=0.001 m/s; no noise learning or motion supplied
config.stress_target: Actual KKT velocity under hypothetical force d*w; geometric P*w scored separately
config.statistics: Independent trajectories are replicates; nine queries and three coordinates averaged within each trajectory. Primary comparisons preselected; other intervals exploratory.
config.posterior: Deterministic complementary normal-line sphere integration with two-resolution diagnostics; no MCMC
config.noisy_intervals: Not evaluated; every interval in this pilot is a clean-response component interval
config.input_program: Plane cycles world axes; curved guide uses fixed world-frame sinusoidal force program
config.query_program: Three axes and normalized pairwise sums/differences, all norm v0
config.reporting: Posterior integration and task decisions at observations60/180/600; corrections every observation

gate.scope: Finite model, mechanics, deterministic-posterior and numerical checks; empirical superiority and coverage remain experimental outcomes
gate.execution: Full general notebook and complete regression suite, isolated contact outputs
